note: City park on Highway 28 just west of Browns Valley, near Lake Traverse and the Little Minnesota River, with picnic areas, restrooms and two shelters. --Claude
summary: City page read: $10 no services / $25 W+E / $35 full (dump $5, weekly $100, monthly $400), 30 A, some sewer, first-come self-pay with no reservations. Booking written; not waterfront kept; no site count or season published.
flags: Long-stay check: weekly ($100) and monthly ($400) rates are posted beside the nightly ones. Imagery shows an open city park with no rows of parked trailers, so it does not look seasonal. No site count is published.
Base rate is $10 (no services), the cheapest site; a 23-ft rig fit is not stated for any site.
Waterfront: not waterfront kept. The Little Minnesota River runs about 150-200 m south-west of the pin behind houses and trees.
Phone 320-695-2110 and website confirmed; pin on the park lawn; no move.
Note cleaned: dropped the hookup, amperage and dump-station text (fields hold them).
